entities.summary: Ada Beatrice Queen Victoria Louise Virginia "Bricktop" Smith DuConge was an American dancer, jazz singer, vaudevillian, and self-described saloon-keeper who owned the famous nightclub Chez Bricktop in Paris from 1924 to 1961, as well as clubs in Mexico City and Rome.
